inputs.label: Projected ice time
inputs.detail: Prior-adjusted workload estimate

inputs.label: Weighted assists / 60
inputs.detail: Prior-adjusted production per 60 minutes

inputs.label: Opponent goals allowed / game
inputs.detail: Recency-weighted; the same figure the game-line model uses

inputs.label: His results vs. our forecasts
inputs.detail: 447 actual vs. 410.1 forecast points in earlier games; shrunk toward 1

steps.label: Opponent goals allowed vs. long-run league average
His results vs. our past forecasts

build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many goals the opponent allows compared with the league. Then adjusted for how he has done against our own forecasts: 447 points against 410.1 forecast in his earlier games, shrunk toward no adjustment. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.

blend.label: Production rate
blend.detail: Recency-weighted games; the rest is the position average

blend.label: Ice time
blend.detail: Recency-weighted games; the rest is the position average

trend.label: assists
trend.note: Faded games count less. A game’s weight halves every 110 of his games for production and every 14 of his games for ice time.

missing: The starting goalie (team defense blends its goalies)
